Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: cluster munition
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Partway through its flight this projectile breaks apart and releases a spread of submunitions that rain down around the target point rather than striking a single cell. Depending on the munition it may also detonate at the moment it splits. It will not split until it is a safe distance from the shooter.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: directional blast
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: On impact this projectile explodes in a cone pointing along its direction of travel instead of a full circle. Anything in the arc ahead of the impact point is hit; things behind or beside it are spared. Aim it so the cone sweeps across the enemy line.
